title: Open Mic Night @ Carolina Bauernhaus Greenville
event_description: Weekly open mic for musicians poets and storytellers hosted by Bauerntender Claire. All genres welcome in a welcoming creative atmosphere at this West Greenville brewery.
event_venue_information:
About Carolina Bauernhaus Greenville

Carolina Bauernhaus Greenville is a popular brewery located in the West Greenville Village area. This brewery offers a welcoming atmosphere for local musicians and artists.

Music Events

The venue hosts weekly open mic nights on Wednesdays where musicians comedians poets and storytellers can share their talents. The brewery also features special music events and has become a cultural hub in the West Greenville community.

Brewery Experience

Carolina Bauernhaus combines craft beer with community events creating a laid-back environment perfect for both performing and enjoying live entertainment. The brewery is known for its support of local artists and maintains a welcoming vibe.

title: Say What Open Mic @ Coffee Underground
event_description: Longest-running poetry showcase in South Carolina with 20+ years of exciting poetry programming. Features open mic slots for local poets on first-come first-serve basis. All poetry styles welcome.
hosts: Wits End Poetry - Host Moody Black
event_venue_information:
About Coffee Underground

Coffee Underground is a beloved downtown Greenville institution that has been operating since 1995. Located just 14 steps down from Main Street at the corner of Coffee and Main this cozy underground venue is a cultural hotspot.

Poetry and Performance Events

Home to Wits End Poetry the longest-running poetry open mic in the Upstate and South Carolina. The venue hosts weekly poetry slams open mics stand-up comedy improv sketch and features from local songwriters. The theater room has been a thriving cultural center showcasing performers from across the region.

Cafe and Atmosphere

Specializing in homemade desserts and coffee with beans roasted on premises Coffee Underground offers an all-day breakfast and lunch menu. The underground location creates an intimate bohemian atmosphere perfect for creative performances and casual gatherings.

title: Open Blues Jam @ Chicora Alley
event_description: Open blues jam on the first second and third Wednesdays of each month. Musicians are invited to bring instruments and amplifiers. Drums and bass provided on site.
venue_address: 608 S Main St Unit B Greenville SC 29601
event_venue_information:
About Chicora Alley

Chicora Alley Downtown is a unique Caribbean-fusion restaurant and bar located near the beautiful Reedy River Falls Park area. The venue has been serving the Greenville community since opening over a decade ago.

Live Music Scene

The venue features live jazz blues and reggae music almost every night. Chicora Alley hosts weekly blues jams and jazz performances creating an intimate atmosphere for musicians and music lovers. Wednesday nights feature blues jams on select weeks and big band performances.

Food and Atmosphere

Offering delicious Caribbean fusion cuisine in a relaxed setting Chicora Alley serves Southern-Caribbean food including vegan options. The second-floor location provides a cozy environment just steps from Falls Park making it a favorite gathering spot for locals and tourists alike.

title: Sunday Jazz Jam @ Fireforge Crafted Beer
event_description: Long-running Greenville Jazz Collective Sunday Jazz Jam. Open jam for musicians of all ages and skill levels interested in improvising jazz with a house band of local jazz professionals.
event_venue_information:
About Fireforge Crafted Beer

Fireforge Crafted Beer is a locally-owned award-winning small-batch craft brewery taproom kitchen and biergarden in downtown Greenville just a 10-minute walk from Bon Secours Wellness Arena.

Music Programming

Fireforge features weekly bluegrass and jazz jams with local musicians. The Sunday Jazz Jam is a long-standing tradition that welcomes musicians of all skill levels. The venue also hosts their annual ForgeFest Music Festival and other special music events throughout the year.

Brewery and Food

With 20+ in-house brewed beers on draft plus wine cider and non-alcoholic beverages Fireforge offers a locally-inspired menu of shareable snacks sandwiches and sides. The brewery has received numerous awards including Best Brewpub/Brewery from Greenville News Community Choice Awards.

title: Open Mic Jam @ 3 Friends Bar & Grill
event_description: Weekly open mic jam session with host and backing band. Musicians of all skill levels welcome to bring instruments and jam. Fun relaxed atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About 3 Friends Bar & Grill

3 Friends Bar & Grill opened in 2017 in Taylors bringing fresh American fare and live music to the Piedmont area. The restaurant has quickly earned a reputation for quality food and fun atmosphere.

Live Music Events

The venue hosts regular open mic nights and live band performances on weekends. Monday nights feature an open mic jam with a house backing band welcoming musicians of all skill levels. Karaoke nights and special performances make this a popular local entertainment destination.

Restaurant Experience

Serving everything fresh with nothing frozen 3 Friends offers a full menu from burgers to pasta to steak and seafood. The full bar provides wine beer and cocktails. The venue includes a private banquet room for parties and events.

title: Open Mic Jam @ Golden Grove Farm & Brew
event_description: Weekly open mic jam session every Monday evening. All skill levels welcome in a laid-back farm brewery setting.
event_venue_information:
About Golden Grove Farm & Brew

Golden Grove Farm & Brew is a unique farm brewery located in Piedmont just outside Greenville. The venue combines craft beer with outdoor activities including an 18-hole disc golf course.

Music Events

Golden Grove hosts weekly open mic jams every Monday and features Funky Dunky on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of each month with guest artists and a house rhythm section. Musicians are encouraged to bring instruments and sit in during the second set.

Brewery Setting

The farm brewery offers award-winning beers in a relaxed outdoor setting. With both indoor and outdoor seating Golden Grove provides a family-friendly atmosphere perfect for enjoying live music and craft beverages.

title: Shane Pruitt Blues Jam @ Blues Boulevard Jazz
event_description: Shane Pruitt Band hosts an open blues jam session. Musicians and vocalists of the blues genre are invited to attend and participate.
event_venue_information:
About Blues Boulevard Jazz

Blues Boulevard Jazz is a premier jazz and blues venue located in downtown Greenville along the scenic River Walk. The venue features a contemporary intimate setting with cozy seating and soft lighting.

Live Music Programming

Blues Boulevard showcases live jazz and blues acts Wednesday through Saturday with special jam sessions on the first Tuesday of each month. The venue features talented local and touring musicians including Jorge Garcia Steve Galloway and regular performances by house band Jazzsmith.

Dining and Atmosphere

The venue offers signature tapas and delectable entrees including salmon with orange-brown sugar Cajun glaze alongside homemade cocktails. The underground jazz parlor atmosphere creates an intimate nostalgic setting for enjoying world-class music.
